image.name: kavita
image.description: [Kavita](https://github.com/Kareadita/Kavita) is a fast, feature rich, cross platform reading server. Built with a focus for being a full solution for all your reading needs. Setup your own server and share your reading collection with your friends and family!

changelog.desc: Rebase to Ubuntu Resolute. Enable jemalloc to reduce memory footprint.
Fix app file perms to prevent high uid.

volumes.desc: Media library containing manga, comics and books.

image.title: Kavita
image.setup_instructions:
Access the webui at `<your-ip>:5000`. Follow the setup wizard on initial install.

The docker cli and compose yml samples provided list a single `/data` folder for the media, however, you can set up multiple mount points if you wish. For instance, you can set up 3 separate mountpoints named `/manga`, `/comics` and `/books`, each mapped to separate folders on host.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  kavita:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/kavita:latest
    container_name: kavita
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/kavita/config:/config
      - /path/to/data:/data #optional
    ports:
      - 5000:5000
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=kavita \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 5000:5000 \
  -v /path/to/kavita/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/data:/data `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/kavita:latest
